description: Somos estudiantes apasionados por la tecnologia y la ciencia. Buscamos sumar personas con ideas, ganas de aprender y diferentes conocimientos para crear juntos un proyecto innovador que combine programación, analisis de datos y soluciones para nuestro planeta.
summary:
LambdaX is a web-based application designed to make NISAR satellite radar imagery easier to explore and understand. It addresses the challenge of making Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data more accessible to the general public by transforming complex radar preview images into intuitive visualizations.

The platform allows users to explore monitored regions through interactive maps, view simplified Before/After comparisons of selected areas, and click on image pixels to access plain-language explanations. A Python-based pipeline retrieves available NISAR scenes from NASA Earthdata and processes their preview imagery into visual overlays that can be explored through the web interface.

By combining satellite data, data processing, and interactive visualization, LambdaX helps users discover how radar technology can reveal changes on Earth's surface, including conditions that optical satellite imagery may not easily capture.
details:
LambdaX is an interactive web application that helps users explore and interpret NASA NISAR Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery. It provides interactive maps for regional monitoring, simplified Before/After comparisons of selected locations, and pixel-level interactions that offer plain-language explanations of radar imagery.

The project includes monitoring examples from Santiago del Estero, Argentina, as well as comparison cases in Mozambique and the Nepal–China border region. A Python script connects to NASA Earthdata to retrieve available NISAR scenes for selected regions, process their preview images, and generate visual overlays. These are then displayed in a web interface.

We used Python 3 and its standard library for data retrieval and processing, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScriptfor the application, Leaflet.js for interactive maps, the HTML5 Canvas API for image visualization, and JSON and CSV for data organization.

Our creative approach was to turn complex radar imagery into an accessible, visual experience inspired by a citizen-oriented mission control interface. We prioritized clarity, ease of exploration, and accessibility for people without technical backgrounds.

The intended impact is to encourage public interest in Earth observation and help more people understand how radar satellites can reveal changes on our planet.
